blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY, Bohol — The Office of the Ombudsman has ordered Cebu City Mayor Nestor Dionson Archival Sr. to pay a fine equivalent to one month’s basic salary after finding him administratively liable for simple neglect of duty over lapses in the operation of the 2025 Colon Street Night Market. The Ombudsman on Wednesday said Archival failed to exercise due diligence in ensuring compliance with operational requirements, particularly coordination with the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) and the issuance of permits. The ruling said records failed to establish that the city government had secured the necessary approval or coordinated […]...
